description: This Java class defines a Fragment called SetupProfileFragment that handles the initiation of managed profile provisioning within an Android application. It provides UI interactions to start device management setup, constructs appropriate provisioning Intents, and handles provisioning results.

classes.name: SetupProfileFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages the initiation of managed profile provisioning on an Android device.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of SetupProfileFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout during view creation.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up click listener for the profile setup button after the view is created.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events; initiates profile provisioning when the setup button is clicked.

methods.name: provisionManagedProfile
methods.description: Starts the device management provisioning process via an Intent, handling different SDK versions.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the provisioning activity, showing success or failure messages.
